rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" autoreconf -vfi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --disable-nls \ --build="$AELTRA_BUILD_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
# HACK: Make sure rpl_{m,re}alloc are explictly declared. sed -i \ -e '/#define malloc rpl_malloc/i #include "rpl_malloc.h"' \ -e '/#define realloc rpl_realloc/i #include "rpl_realloc.h"' \ src/config.h
rules.install: cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -C src DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install-exec-hook
